subject: Only enable defrag for vendored jemalloc (#1985)
reason: This is a build-time guard: HAVE_DEFRAG now requires VALKEY_VENDORED_JEMALLOC, a macro the vendored jemalloc header defines. The fuzzer's builds of both the change and its parent use the vendored jemalloc, so HAVE_DEFRAG is defined on both and runtime behavior (activedefrag config, defrag cycle) is identical. The only difference appears when linking against a system jemalloc, a build configuration the runner does not produce, so no scenario can reach the changed path.
